places.body: The address search in the DMS uses Google Maps Platform (Places API). By using the address suggestions you agree to be bound by <terms>Google's Terms of Service</terms>; <privacy>Google's Privacy Policy</privacy> applies to Google's processing. A business can switch the feature off at any time under Administration › Business › Address entry.

When an address is entered in the DMS, the typed address text — and only that, never a name or any other customer data — is sent to Google Ireland Limited to show suggestions. Google processes it as a separate controller under the Google Maps Platform Terms of Service and the Google Controller-Controller Data Protection Terms (including the standard contractual clauses for transfers from Switzerland). Only the address the user picks is stored. A business can switch the feature off at any time under Administration › Business › Address entry.
places.google: How Google processes this data is described in <privacy>Google's Privacy Policy</privacy>; <terms>Google's Terms of Service</terms> also apply to the address suggestions.
